status: Focused conversation lifecycle implementation verified; full checkpoint integration remains a separate parent check

scope.execution: Hidden offscreen real MainWindow widgets, menu action object names and dialog buttons. Temporary profiles and temporary Git repositories only. A loopback held HTTP fixture is the only provider used; no live credentials or services.

sourceContracts.contract: Fork active/persisted chat state and source approval mode; archive stops/unloads the agent and preserves persisted history and attachment blobs; permanent deletion removes owned persisted context.
The host resolves a previous active chat first; failure or absence falls through to default startup behavior.
Archived rows show title/date/workspace, per-row delete and Unarchive actions, a confirmation dialog, 25-row increments and a 250 ms debounced search.
Archived records are ordered by archive timestamp, then last activity. Native legacy records without archivedAt use updated as an explicit compatibility fallback.
Ordinary new chats inherit the current chat's stored approval mode.
The sidebar new-chat action passes the open chat's approval mode; a missing value leaves the backend default.
setAgentArchived writes the current time when archiving and null when unarchiving; missing agent IDs fail. Native persists archivedAt as milliseconds and retains zero as a legacy fallback marker.

verifiedBehavior: Forked history, uploaded blobs and captured file-read snapshots remain usable after the source conversation is permanently deleted. Destination attachment snapshots are separately read and compared before deletion.
Fork clears unsent draft text/attachments, keeps source state independent and preserves the source approval policy even when another chat is selected.
Archiving a busy chat cancels the held provider request, persists history and archive time, revokes the old read lease, unloads engine/host and retains attachment bytes and snapshot storage.
Restoring clears archivedAt and makes the row active without implicitly activating a host/workspace until selected.
Cancellation of permanent deletion preserves session bytes and owned files. Confirmation removes the selected chat and its owned file context; another chat remains selected.
The Delete menu action is disabled while busy, and a confirmation opened before the agent becomes busy is rechecked and refused.

Archive row actions target their bound conversation ID even when a different row is selected. Archive sorting, legacy timestamp fallback, stable equal ties, 25/50/53 pagination and debounced search are checked.
Concurrent persisted session changes block new, rename, fork, archive, delete, restore and selection changes without overwriting external bytes or losing the current draft/selection.

Loaded live workspace owners remain mounted across ordinary chat switches and are released on archive. Unselected stored history alone is not a live mount. A source host hydrated by a background fork is represented in live ownership.
The last selected nonarchived chat and its draft are restored at restart; an archived saved selection falls back to an active chat.

Ask/Always allow are persisted per chat, restored on selection/restart, copied from the source on fork, inherited by ordinary new chats and rolled back when saving a selector change conflicts. Legacy omitted values default to Ask.

A rejected malformed inherited tool history preserves the raw draft whitespace, draft attachment references, prior history and rejection message. UI/durable/reopened drafts agree and no provider request is sent.

concreteFindings.finding: selectConversation ignored a failed previous-draft save, changed selection and cleared the error
concreteFindings.resolution: Root preserves current ID/composer, restores the list highlight and returns before publishing the destination

concreteFindings.finding: A background fork could hydrate a nonarchived source host without registering a live workspace owner
concreteFindings.resolution: Root registers nonarchived source hydration in engineFor and refreshes Git context

concreteFindings.finding: Sending into malformed inherited history cleared and persisted the draft before the engine rejected the submission
concreteFindings.beforeResult: All three data rows failed: visible, durable and reopened draft text were empty; both rows with attachments also lost their draft references
concreteFindings.resolution: AgentEngine returns explicit message acceptance. MainWindow restores the prior raw draft and references only for a rejected submission whose owner/history still match; an accepted turn is not undone merely because it later fails or is synchronously cancelled

validation.ownership: Parent built and ran targets. qt_port_review authored the fixtures and original audit; license_review checked the recorded suite counts/source references and preserved immutable report copies. license_review did not build or run these targets during this audit handoff.
validation.helperWarnings: Two misleading-indentation warnings in test menu helpers were corrected. Offscreen platform capability warnings are expected and are retained in the logs.

explicitLimits: Passing focused fixtures establish these scenarios, not universal zero defects or full Stagewise parity.
Native approval policy currently represents Ask and Always allow. Upstream Smart mode is not implemented by this bool slice.
Conversation still stores one workspace. The private usage journal and destructive worktree cleanup remain outside this integration; usageKnown remains false.
Fork tests cover persisted/idle/background source history, not every in-flight streaming boundary, side-chat promotion or complete branch UI semantics.
Cleanup retry/root locking and corrupt metadata behavior have separate SessionStore fixtures; these MainWindow tests do not simulate power loss, disk-full or every simultaneous external writer race.
Attachment-reference preservation is verified through stored metadata, actual owned blob bytes and restart. This suite does not establish pixel-level attachment-chip appearance.
Archive layout uses native widgets. Screenshot parity is reviewed separately; hidden lifecycle fixtures are not a visual parity claim.
The broader full checkpoint suite and live packaged executable validation are parent-owned follow-up checks.

Child-agent/side-chat lifecycle, multi-workspace chat state and paired live upstream/native interaction are not completed or validated by this slice. The existing bool approval adapter does not implement upstream Smart approval semantics.
